title: Mini Game Survival v10
about: T-Rexy, a cute little T-Rex with a tiny jump, wakes up alone in the glitchy neon Glitch Nebula after weird music swoops him away from home. He runs four obstacle portals (bounce pads, ship tunnels, spikes), rebuilds his memories in jigsaw puzzles, spells science clue words before the glitch drains his fuel, types each clue into his notebook, and builds a spaceship to get home. Then he solves the mystery of Shadowspine, the giant all-black Spinosaurus. Hidden diary pages and other secrets, shooting stars and comets crossing the story sky, hardcore music, adaptive difficulty, and an arcade high score board. Every character and prop is drawn in one shared cartoon style, and every look T-Rexy unlocks fits him, even in his ship's cockpit. Every mini game finished unlocks a new look for his closet: hats, colors, things for his back, and whole outfits (a mad scientist, a surfer, and a punk rock biker). On the title screen, the Wave Rider bonus level: ride a board over rolling neon hills, hold to dive and let go to fly, and catch stars for a best score.

tagline: Weird music zapped T-Rexy into space!
Dodge spikes. Crack the mystery. Get home!

releases.notes: First version: four portals (obstacle runs, memory jigsaws, glitch-locked clue words, clue typing), the Shadow Gate, the mystery of Shadowspine, secret diary pages, hardcore songs, adaptive levels, high scores.

Easier runs that ramp up portal by portal, a double hop, Easy and Hard modes, no attempt counting, a funnier opening with dinosaur and space puns, upbeat music, NASA-inspired neon backgrounds, detailed memory pictures, a one-piece Shadowspine with an evil laugh, a question library, and the Zoomasaurus end clip.

Every memory piece catchable (checked in every play-test), missing pieces leave holes in the memory jigsaw with a keep-going or run-again choice and a full-catch bonus, L and R move back and forward through the story, hints that show the keys only when a player is stuck, and a real recorded villain laugh (CC0).

Checkpoints always on; Hard mode needs every memory piece to move on; obstacles on the beat with the music kept in time; PERFECT hops; catch sparkles, landing dust, and a crash shake; 12 unlockable looks for T-Rexy and his closet on the crash pad.

A cuter, more expressive T-Rexy: big shiny eyes, a brow that shows his mood, rosier blush, new faces (blink, excited, determined, worried with a sweat drop), blinking, reactions during runs, and squash and stretch on hops.

Cute recorded dino noises (each dinosaur in its own voice), phone and tablet play (tap tips, back and forward buttons, the phone keyboard for clues, layouts for upright and sideways phones), T-Rexy beside his crashed ship that gets fixed part by part, and a much bigger question library dealt so every game is new.

Hints moved off the play area (a banner across the top of the sky, the floor under a run, a strip under the jigsaw); a space helmet that fits T-Rexy's whole head; T-Rexy sitting inside the cockpit in his color and hat; every look checked for fit; one shared drawing style for every character and prop (eyes, ink lines, shading, glass, sparkles); shooting stars, meteor showers, comets, satellites, tiny rockets, and twinkles on the story screens; the sky seam fixed.

Looks come much faster: every mini game finished (each portal's run, jigsaw, and clue word) unlocks the next look for T-Rexy, so all 12 can be found in one game, and the Shadow Gate run makes up for a skipped one. Full catches still earn the bonus points. The closet only shows the empty slots that can still be filled this game.

Three new outfits for T-Rexy's closet, 15 looks in all: the Mad Scientist (lab coat, goggles, a bubbling potion), the Surfer Dino (board shorts, a flower lei, sunscreen on his snout, a surfboard), and the Punk Rock Biker (studded leather jacket, chain, pink mohawk). Outfits mix with every hat, color, and back item, and he wears them in the cockpit too. A new player finds 13 looks in the first game and the last 2 in the next.

The Wave Rider bonus level, on the title screen and open from the start: T-Rexy rides a neon board over rolling hills under a neon sunset. Hold to dive down the hills, let go to fly off the tops, land smooth for combos, catch stars, 60 seconds with nothing to crash into, and a best score kept on that computer. Its own song, "Wave Rider", joins the jukebox.
